requirements.text: We are seeking a software engineering intern who can design and maintain modern, scalable applications while owning our cloud and infrastructure layer. You’ll build responsive user interfaces, develop backend APIs, and architect deployments that can scale globally. OAuth/OIDC. You’ll thrive if you’ve worked on platform or infra teams (Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS) or as a product engineer at performance-oriented orgs (Stripe, Notion, etc.). Check out plan.terranova.inc for an idea of some of the web dev stuff you'll need to develop.
Design and implement performant, maintainable web apps using TypeScript, React/Next.js, and Node/FastAPI/Go.
Build and operate distributed backends with Postgres, Redis, and task queues.
Manage infrastructure-as-code deployments (Terraform/CDK) on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Implement CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and incident-response workflows.
